chapters.reason: Introduces planning tokens to guide reasoning using trainable tokens with minimal parameter overhead, aligning with latent-space/hidden guidance of thought.
Focuses on structuring/streamlining chain-of-thought reasoning; the planning mechanism aims to impose a higher-level plan on the CoT steps.
Paper reports evaluations on math word problems and multihop QA datasets, indicating its benchmarking of reasoning ability (evaluation and benchmark aspect).
